trace.final:
All done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest production deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.0 was healthy; intervening v2.3.1-rc was only in staging). Verified the rollback: the service is now healthy in all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged), describing the v2.3.1 health-check failures, the full-region rollback to v2.3.0, and a note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the failure is root-caused. (The first incident-creation attempt hit a transient 503; the retry succeeded.)
